| `getZoom()` | Gets the camera's current zoom level |


| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `closeInterfaceWithEsc()` | If closing interfaces with esc is enabled in the game, this will close interfaces with the esc key |
| `gainFocus()` | Emulates alt+tabbing to gain focus on the client Ignored if client already has focus |
| `getCurrentModifiers()` | Currently held down modifiers, shift, ctrl, alt, etc Use bitwise checks on events like InputEvent.SHIFT_MASK to check if modifier is active |
| `getKeyboardTypingAlgorithm()` | Keyboard typing algorithm, handles the actual typing implementations |
| `getWordsPerMinute()` | Gets the current KeyboardProfile.getWordsPerMinute() |
| `holdControl(Condition release)` | Holds Key.CTRL until the given Condition.verify() returns true Defaults to a 3 second timeout Defaults to the KeyLocation.LEFT control Can be canceled using markHeld(Key, boolean) with false |
| `holdControl(Condition release, long timeout)` | Holds Key.CTRL until the given Condition.verify() returns true or the given timeout is reached Defaults to the KeyLocation.LEFT control Can be canceled using markHeld(Key, boolean) with false |
| `holdKey(Key key, Condition release)` | See holdKey(Key, Condition, long) with a default timeout of 3000 |
| `holdKey(Key key, Condition release, long timeout)` | Submits a new HoldKey with a given Key until the given Condition.verify() returns true or the passed in timeout is reached. |
| `holdShift(Condition release)` | Holds Key.SHIFT until the given Condition.verify() returns true Defaults to a 3 second timeout Defaults to the KeyLocation.LEFT shift Can be canceled using markHeld(Key, boolean) with false |
| `holdShift(Condition release, long timeout)` | Holds Key.SHIFT until the given Condition.verify() returns true or the given timeout is reached Defaults to the KeyLocation.LEFT shift Can be canceled using markHeld(Key, boolean) with false |
| `holdSpace(Condition release)` | Holds Key.SPACE until the given Condition.verify() returns true Defaults to a 3 second timeout Can be canceled using markHeld(Key, boolean) with false |
| `holdSpace(Condition release, long timeout)` | Holds Key.SPACE until the given Condition.verify() returns true or the given timeout is reached Can be canceled using markHeld(Key, boolean) with false |
| `isHeld(Key key)` | Checks if a given Key is currently being held |
| `isPressed(Key key)` | Checks if a key is pressed |
| `loseFocus()` | Emulates alt+tabbing to lose focus on the client Ignored if client currently does not have focus |
| `markHeld(Key key, boolean held)` | Marks the Key as being held, does NOT send any events. |
| `markPressed(Key key)` | Marks the given Key as pressed. |
| `markReleased(Key key)` | Marks a given Key as released. |
| `pressEsc()` | Presses the ESC key Handles full press/release |
| `pressShift()` | Calls the PressKey event for Key.SHIFT Defaults to the KeyLocation.LEFT shift Does NOT handle release. |
| `releaseChar(char character)` | Creates and runs a ReleaseEvent on a character. |
| `releaseKey(Key key)` | Releases a Key if it marked as pressed or held |
| `releaseShift()` | Calls the ReleaseKey event for Key.SHIFT Defaults to the KeyLocation.LEFT shift |
| `setKeyboardTypingAlgorithm(KeyboardTypingAlgorithm algo)` | Sets the Keyboard typing algorithm, parent class of KeyboardTypingAlgorithm |
| `setWordsPerMinute(double wpm)` | Sets the KeyboardProfile.setWordsPerMinute(double) |
| `type(Object message)` | Types out a given message, will press enter at the end if successful |
| `type(Object message, boolean enter)` | Types out a given message, optionally pressing enter |
| `type(Object message, boolean enter, boolean makeMistakes)` | Types out a given message, optionally pressing enter and optionally making mistakes |
| `type(Object message, boolean enter, Condition stop)` | Types out a given message, optionally pressing enter Uses a stop Condition that will cause the typing to be interrupted and stopped. |
| `typeKey(int keyCode)` | Types a Key based on the keyCode passed in. |
| `typeKey(Key key)` | Types a Key Handles the full press, type(if necessary), release Defaults to not push enter. |

| `mouseDownUntil(int timeout, Condition c)` | Hold mouse down until condition is true, with specified timeout Does not create its own thread! |
| `move()` | Moves the mouse to random gaussian distributed destination near the location of your current position if the mouse is on screen, otherwise will base position from center of canvas. |
| `move(Point point)` | Moves the mouse to a specified point |
| `move(Rectangle rectangle)` | Moves the mouse to a specified rectangle |
| `move(AbstractMouseDestination <?> destination)` | Moves the mouse to a destination Does not click" If isAlwaysHop() is true, automatically adjust to call hop(Point) using AbstractMouseDestination.getSuitablePoint() |
| `move(Entity entity)` | Moves the mouse to a destination |
| `moveOutsideScreen()` | Moves the mouse outside the screen and sends a focus lost event to the canvas See moveOutsideScreen(boolean) with param true |
| `moveOutsideScreen(boolean loseFocus)` | Moves mouse outside the screen, losing focus based on loseFocus parameter Does not run if mouse is not in screen If loseFocus is true see loseFocus(int) with a default time of random(100,3000) |

| `scroll(boolean up, int timeout, Condition c)` | Scrolls mouse until the condition is true, with specified timeout |
| `scrollDown(int timeout, Condition c)` | Scrolls mouse wheel down until Condition is true or timeout is met |
| `scrollUntil(boolean up, int timeout, Condition c)` | Scrolls mouse until the condition is true, with specified timeout |
| `scrollUp(int timeout, Condition c)` | Scrolls mouse wheel up until Condition is true or timeout is met |
| `setLastCrosshairColorId(int last)` | Set internally during mouse click operations |
| `setLastCrosshairColorID(int last)` | Deprecated. |
| `setMouseAlgorithm(MouseAlgorithm algorithm)` | Sets the mouse algorithm implementation the client uses for mouse movement and clicks |

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `clickAndSkipItem()` | Clicks 5, sleeps, pushes 8 then 2 twice |
| `dropColumn(int column, Filter <Item> dropFilter)` | Drops all the items in a given column that match the given filter |
| `dropItem(Item item, Filter <Item> dropFilter)` | Checks the item against the given filter, if the item is null or dropFilter doesn't match, it skips it otherwise calls mouseKeyCombo |
| `dropItems(Filter <Item> dropFilter)` | Drops all items in all rows that match the dropFilter |
| `getJumpDistance()` | Gets the mouse jump distance in pixels |
| `initialColumnMouseCheck(int column, Filter <Item> dropFilter)` | Moves mouse to the top item in the column and right clicks, returns if menu is visible |
| `mouseKeyCombo()` | Pushes 5, sleeps, pushes 2, sleeps |
| `pushEight()` | Jumps up by the jump distance |
| `pushFive()` | Left clicks and then right clicks with no delay between |
| `pushFour()` | Jumps left by the jump distance |
| `pushNine()` | Jumps up and right by the jump distance |
| `pushOne()` | Jumps down and to the left by the jump distance |
| `pushSeven()` | Jumps up and left by the jump distance |
| `pushSix()` | Jumps right by the jump distance |
| `pushThree()` | Jumps down and right by the jump distance |
| `pushTwo()` | Jumps down by the jump distance |
| `setKeySleeps(int min, int max)` | Sets the min and max values for the sleep between key presses Will throw exceptions if you give negative values or if min is greater than or equal to max |
| `setYJumpDistance(int jump)` | Sets the jump distance in pixels |
| `skipItem()` | if menu is visible, clicks and skips next item, otherwise pushes 2 |
| `tabCheck()` | Checks if the inventory tab is open, if it isn't it opens it |
